proposals.previous_suggestion: conflict handling gives the same error: A 409 handed back to a call that does not expect one fails model validation and maps to the same invalid_backend_api_response error as raising it directly.
proposals.review_note: A 409 response containing an otherwise-valid OrderRecord is returned as success instead of being rejected for its status.

proposals.previous_suggestion: conflict handling gives the same error: A 409 handed back to a call that does not expect one fails model validation and maps to the same invalid_backend_api_response error as raising it directly.
proposals.review_note: The OR condition returns unexpected statuses; a 400 with a valid Appointment, or a 409 with a valid OrderRecord, can be accepted instead of rejected.

proposals.previous_suggestion: blank field check, later check rejects the same input: A blank required field makes the next validator (base URL, model, auth mode) reject it with the same configuration error, so the blank-field pre-check is redundant for the outcome.
proposals.review_note: EMBED_MODEL=XXXX is a permitted nonempty model name. The variant incorrectly rejects this complete valid profile.

proposals.previous_suggestion: blank field check, later check rejects the same input: A blank required field makes the next validator (base URL, model, auth mode) reject it with the same configuration error, so the blank-field pre-check is redundant for the outcome.
proposals.review_note: TTS_ES_MODEL or TTS_ES_VOICE equal to XXXX are valid nonempty values; the variant incorrectly rejects them.

proposals.previous_suggestion: temp file bookkeeping: The temporary file is created, written, closed and removed inside the same call; the value of the staging marker before it is set, or an empty write, is never observed.
proposals.review_note: Writing four bytes instead of zero can fail on a filesystem/file-size limit that permits creating an empty file. The readiness result then changes. This cannot be certified equivalent merely because the probe file is deleted.
proposals.followup_note: Closed the original zero-byte readiness false positive using a one-byte write to an automatically removed temporary file. Real POSIX write-limit tests cover failure, success and cleanup. All six variants generated for the corrected current function were killed by mutmut 3.8.0. This does not alter the historical run or approve its behavior-changing variant.

proposals.review_note: Cancelling a turn while its safety lookup waits leaves the independently scheduled extraction running when the finally guard is inverted.

proposals.previous_suggestion: response fields that hold the same value: The omitted or replaced field already has that value at this point (an empty review has no pending issues or citations; verification cannot still be required after it succeeded; the session id inside a replay digest adds nothing because replay records are stored per session; the flow is always finished at this point).
proposals.review_note: A supported persisted booking replay record contains the fingerprint of the real session UUID. Replacing that UUID with None makes an identical retry after restart conflict with its saved record.
An unanswerable Spanish question is answered with English abstention when reply_language is omitted.
